status: PROPOSAL -- registered, not granted, not run (authorization.proposed.json)
_contract: REGISTERED BEFORE ANY SESSION. Stage V of topk_adoption_driver.py (phase_d2/d2_gpu_validation.py) on ONE L40S, on the launcher, remote payload and campaign mechanism stage L and R0 ran on. Engineering validation of the redesigned D2 objective only: no D2 search, no recovery training, no behavioural probe. AUTHORIZES NOTHING by itself: authorization.json does, and it does not exist until the maintainer grants.

formal_topology._frozen: D2's search runs only this; every gate below is measured under it

steps.what: pod setup, environment, teacher fetch and load, the stage-V $0 premises on the pod
the root store of BOTH profiles at the formal bsz=3 and at bsz=1; arithmetic on identical teacher logits; the teacher-confidence validity report per profile
steps.why_gpu: the real teacher's full-vocabulary entropy is the question

steps.what: rebuild B as stage L did; B's per-position root KL on both profiles; the c x KL reduction arithmetic on identical (KL, c); the validity report with B's KL
steps.why_gpu: the c_T-KL relation needs a real compressed student

steps.what: B under KL-only and the D2 objective at bsz=3 all_v1, the D2 objective at bsz=3 scored_v1 and at bsz=1 all_v1
steps.why_gpu: the overhead, the raw-KL control and the scored_v1 equivalence of THIS objective on the real suite

steps.what: FFN, WIDTH and ATTENTION at the root, full scope (weighted) vs narrow scope (unweighted): timing and selection overlap
steps.why_gpu: how far the teacher's confidence moves a REAL selection

steps.what: one DEPTH round on V3's full-scope FFN child (a non-root parent) under the D2 objective at all_v1: parent KL, unweighted root KL and weighted root KL of the same candidates, their rankings, the confidence IQR/ESS, both cache modes
steps.why_gpu: the reference change acts only below the root
steps.gates: integrity (root reference, table consistency); rankings diagnostic

steps.what: the same DEPTH round at scored_v1
steps.why_gpu: THIS objective's scored_v1 equivalence (stage L's covers the superseded one)

arithmetic.what: one set of inputs, two computations: float32 chunked entropy vs float64 on the SAME teacher logits, chunk 512 vs 64, the confidence mapping, the c x KL item mean vs float64 on the SAME (KL, c), the raw-KL control of one state evaluation
arithmetic.justification:
-- one set of inputs, two computations. The full-vocabulary
   entropy in float32 chunks against float64 on the SAME teacher logits, at two
   chunk sizes; the confidence mapping; the `c x KL` fixed-denominator item
   mean against float64 on the SAME (KL, c); the state evaluator's raw KL
   against D1's KL metric of the same evaluation. GATED by
   :data:`ARITHMETIC_TOLERANCES`. Nothing about the model's execution can move
   these, so a tolerance here is a statement about float32 arithmetic alone.

execution_drift.why_not_gated: a different micro-batch is a different GEMM shape on BF16 and so a different computation; R0's 1e-5 compares two paths under ONE batch shape and does not transfer. D2's topology is frozen at bsz=3, so this drift cannot reach a D2 result: REPORTED, never gated

row_equivalence.what: all_v1 vs scored_v1 at the formal bsz=3: one DEPTH round (V4 vs V5) and the state evaluation (V6)

checks: the teacher binding and B's four identities
each root store's identity equals its declaration at bsz=1 and bsz=3
every DEPTH decision score equals the recorded weighted objective, and every round-0 candidate carries its parent KL

diagnostics.rule: recorded as measured -- including a narrow dynamic range of c_T or an unchanged ranking -- and never a reason to change a definition, a normalization, the scope or a tolerance after the fact

acceptance.verdicts: arithmetic and integrity PASS -> validation PASS; scored_rows_equivalence PASS -> D2 may run scored_v1, otherwise all_v1

basis.setup_and_b_rebuild: d2_budget's reference-calibration components (R0's measured setup, stage L's measured B rebuild)

hardware.why: the GPU stage L and R0 ran on: their timings are this plan's basis, and the 4B teacher plus B, one child and the stores fit

totals._grant_shape: stage L's: the cap covers setup and every core step at its bound; the extended V5 runs inside it whenever earlier work beats its bound

deliverables: root stores: identities, content digests, build seconds
the teacher-confidence validity report per profile, with B's KL
full- vs narrow-scope selection overlap per operator
DEPTH: parent KL, unweighted and weighted root KL of the same candidates on a non-root parent, with rankings
measured replacements for the PROVISIONAL terms of the D2 search price
does_not: change any definition: results are descriptive

evidence.on_the_pod: adoption.json (stage V under V_d2_validation), flushed after every step and written on every exit path; journal.jsonl
evidence.booking: scripts/shared/pod/book_engineering_subrun.py copies the small evidence into runs/<run>/, books cost.json's all-in cost and the evidence sha256 in campaign.json; derive_budget.py then counts it, and d2_budget.d2_validation_evidence reads it
